title: A GST-registered gym's monthly profit counts the GST it owes the government as its own money
what: Every fee is stored as the full amount the member paid, with the GST inside it. The monthly Collection and Profit on the Expenses page add those full amounts and take away only the spending. For a gym with a GST number, about 5 rupees in every 105 collected is tax the gym must pay over, but the page shows it as profit, with no word that tax is inside.
expected: For a gym with a GST number, profit is shown before tax (or the page says plainly that GST is still inside the number).
who: owners of gyms with a GST number
fix_line: Take the GST out of fees received by a registered gym before working out profit, or label the number as including GST

title: Money collected on Your growth is smaller than Collected on Expenses for the same month when the gym runs a shop
what: Your growth counts only fee receipts as Money collected. The Expenses page counts fees plus shop orders handed over as Collected. A gym with a shop sees two different collected amounts for the same month, and Your growth does not say shop sales are left out.
expected: The same month shows the same collected amount everywhere, or each page names what it counts (fees only, or fees and shop).
who: owners of gyms with a shop
how_often: every month with a shop sale
fix_line: Call the growth line Fees collected, or add shop sales to it the way Expenses does
